summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release announcing its third quarterly dividend for 2026 of US$0.195 per share, an 18% increase from 2025. The dividend is payable September 3, 2026 to shareholders of record August 20, 2026. The company also noted it will issue shares through its Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP) at average market price with no discount. This is a routine quarterly dividend announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; watch for future dividend changes.
